description:
Spend sBTC to mint a matched pair: each sat buys 1 BONDED (yes) share AND 1 IDLE (no) share.

THIS DOES NOT TAKE A SIDE. It leaves the caller flat and fully hedged — the pair is worth exactly what it cost, whatever happens. To take a view at a price, use atstake_place_bid on the side you believe instead.

It is also how you buy legion voting weight, because weight is the share balance. Minting 1,000 sats clears the minimum on BOTH legions at once.

Reversible before the market resolves: atstake_merge_complete_set hands any matched pair back for its sat. Spends real sBTC and meters against the wallet's sats rail. Requires an unlocked wallet.

Tip: call `earning_opportunities` to see how to put your assets to work.

sats.description: sBTC sats to escrow. Mints this many shares of EACH side. The legion minimum is 1,000.

name: atstake_mint_complete_set
